user.description: Set up Guest Access. Guests, their trackers and approvals are managed on the Guest Access page afterwards.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Guest Access is already set up.

missing_tracker.title: Tracker of {guest} is missing
missing_tracker.description: {guest} uses `{entity}`, which no longer exists. The guest cannot count through this tracker. Change the trackers of {guest} on the Guest Access page.

missing_resident.title: Resident is missing
missing_resident.description: The resident `{entity}` no longer exists. Guest Access does not see this person come home, so it may think only guests are home and lock rooms. Change the residents on the Guest Access page.

missing_door.title: Door contact of {room} is missing
missing_door.description: The door contact `{entity}` of {room} no longer exists. The room lock cannot see this door, so opening it raises no room violation. Choose another door contact on the Guest Access page.

missing_area.title: Lockable room is missing
missing_area.description: The area `{area}` with the door contact `{entity}` no longer exists, so the room cannot be locked. Remove it or choose another area on the Guest Access page.
